thesis.thesis:
PRELIMINARY / RESEARCHING — not an investment recommendation. Case W03F-r1.

Provenance: all figures below come from a single deterministic screen run against the local evaluation fixture `fixture_id=synthetic-screen-v2` (`synthetic: true`, source kind `deterministic_screen`, as_of 2026-10-18T13:11:10Z, stale_after 2026-10-18T19:11:10Z). FICC and FICD are synthetic fixture tickers, not real issuers; no live market data, filings, or third-party estimates were consulted.

Screen outcome: FICC was the sole retained candidate (passed=1) under `require_complete=true`. Exact metric values as returned by the tool: P/E trailing = 16.5; free cash flow = 310; ROIC = 0.13. Supporting screen values: revenue growth YoY = 0.12; earnings growth YoY = 0.14; debt/equity = 0.22; analyst upside = 0.31.

Missingness boundary: FICD was rejected with reason `insufficient_data` and missing_metrics = ["earnings_growth_yoy"]; it was moved to rejected rather than passed on partial data (runtime_quality_policy.moved_to_rejected = 1, quality flag `incomplete_screen_candidates_rejected`). No thesis is created for FICD. For FICC, the screen reports completeness 1.0 against the required metric set (pe_trailing, revenue_growth_yoy, earnings_growth_yoy, debt_to_equity, free_cash_flow, roic, analyst_upside_pct), but completeness here means only that these seven screen fields were populated — it does not establish that any figure is audited, period-matched, or independently verified. Units are as returned by the fixture (free cash flow 310 is unlabeled as to currency/scale; ROIC 0.13 and growth rates are decimals). No filing dates, fiscal period labels, or accounting-basis disclosures were supplied, so none are asserted.

Working hypothesis (to be tested, not established): a fixture profile of moderate trailing valuation (P/E 16.5), positive free cash flow (310), and ROIC of 0.13 with low leverage (debt/equity 0.22) would be consistent with a cash-generative, conservatively financed business. This is a description of the fixture inputs, not a validated finding.

Open items before any substantive decision: confirm real-issuer identity and provenance; obtain period-labeled, accounting-basis-disclosed financials; reconcile free-cash-flow definition and units; verify ROIC calculation basis; and re-screen FICD once earnings_growth_yoy is available. Fixture data is stale after 2026-10-18T19:11:10Z.
